verdict.rationale: Subscription billing is a fair question for a payments platform, but the evidence pack never documents subscription plans, trials, upgrades, or proration. The only subscription mention is that plugins connect to third-party platforms that run subscription services. That is a host-platform capability, not Checkout.com's own billing feature, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can set up recurring subscription billing with plans, trials, upgrades, and proration
